baseline_always_on_pass_at_2_mean.principle: Mean held-out pass@2 for the object_count + palette_histogram_shape always-on baseline.

baseline_definitions.selected_subset_rule: Within each split, maximize train pass@2, then train transpose captures, then smaller subset; held-out rows are used only for final metrics.

best_subset_stable.principle: True when one exact selected subset wins at least half of grouped splits.

delta_over_always_on.principle: Held-out mean pass@2 minus the always-on baseline mean.

delta_over_single_refuted.principle: Held-out mean pass@2 minus the refuted directional singleton mean.

field_principles.baseline_always_on_pass_at_2_mean: Mean held-out pass@2 for the object_count + palette_histogram_shape always-on baseline.
field_principles.best_subset_stable: True when one exact selected subset wins at least half of grouped splits.
field_principles.delta_over_always_on: Held-out mean pass@2 minus the always-on baseline mean.
field_principles.delta_over_single_refuted: Held-out mean pass@2 minus the refuted directional singleton mean.
field_principles.gap1_hardened_positive: BARE top-level boolean used by exp5210 gate. True only if held-out mean pass@2 beats both baselines and the paired delta CI excludes harmful regression.
field_principles.heldout_pass_at_2_mean: Mean held-out pass@2 for the train-selected subset over grouped splits.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ and say whether GAP-1 set-search remains positive after hardening.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Must remain verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates; no live LLM inference.
field_principles.leakage_audit_passed: True only when scoring avoids test-gold features, held-out rows are never used for selection, and train/eval task-id groups are disjoint.
field_principles.n_grouped_splits: Number of repeated task-id-grouped train/held-out splits.
field_principles.ops_verifier_gaps_updated: True when the GAP-1 section in ops/verifier_gaps.md was updated.
field_principles.paired_delta_ci95: Paired 95% CI over per-split min(selected-always_on, selected-single_refuted) deltas.
field_principles.random_seed: Seed base used for deterministic repeated grouped splits.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: SHA-256 checksum over the terminal artifact with this field blanked.
field_principles.single_refuted_directional_pass_at_2_mea: Mean held-out pass@2 for the directional_adjacency_refuted_20260609 singleton baseline.
